C0080.title: Chongqing Police Dismantle 'Video QR Code Injection' Scheme for Aiding Information Network Crimes
C0080.summary: A typical case released by the Ministry of Public Security reported that Chongqing cyber police found a gang led by Kang earning advertising fees from pornography, gambling, and fraud platforms. The gang received QR codes containing gambling and pornography links, inserted them into short videos, and published hundreds of thousands of coded videos through platform accounts to divert traffic. Chongqing police arrested 12 suspects, destroyed three dens, and seized more than 100 devices and over 20 million yuan in involved funds.
